Main.sentence: Birch Evans " Evan " Bayh III ( /baɪ/ ___E:BY U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Pronunciation_respelling_key)___ ;  born December 26, 1955) is an American politician who served as the ___E:46th governor of Indiana U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_governors_of_Indiana)___ from 1989 to 1997 and as a ___E:United States senator U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Senate)___ representing ___E:Indiana U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indiana)___ from 1999 to 2011. A member of the ___E:Democratic Party U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Democratic_Party_(United_States))___ , he served on the ___E:President's Intelligence Advisory Board U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/President%27s_Intelligence_Advisory_Board)___ under President ___E:Joe Biden U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joe_Biden)___ .

Bayh is the son of Senator ___E:Birch Bayh U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Birch_Bayh)___ and the grandson of basketball coach ___E:Birch Bayh U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Birch_Bayh_(coach))___ .

He was first elected to public office as the ___E:Secretary of State of Indiana U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Secretary_of_State_of_Indiana)___ in 1986. He held the position for two years before being elected governor.
He left his office after completing two terms and briefly took a job lecturing at ___E:Indiana University Bloomington U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indiana_University_Bloomington)___ .

He was elected to Congress as a senator in ___E:1998 U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Senate_election_in_Indiana,_1998)___ and reelected in ___E:2004 U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Senate_election_in_Indiana,_2004)___ .
On February 15, 2010, Bayh unexpectedly announced he would not seek reelection to the Senate in ___E:2010 U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2010_United_States_Senate_election_in_Indiana)___ .

After leaving the Senate, he was replaced by his predecessor, ___E:Dan Coats U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dan_Coats)___ , and became a partner with the law and consulting firm ___E:McGuireWoods U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/McGuireWoods)___ in the firm's Washington, D.C., office,  and also became a senior adviser with ___E:Apollo Global Management U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apollo_Global_Management)___ .

He was a part-time contributor for ___E:Fox News U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fox_News_Channel)___ from March 2011 to July 2016.  In June 2011 he became a messaging adviser for the ___E:U.S. Chamber of Commerce U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/U.S._Chamber_of_Commerce)___ .
On October 27, 2011, it was announced that ___E:Berry Plastics Corp. U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Berry_Global)___ had appointed Bayh to its board of directors.

Following the withdrawal of 2016 Democratic primary winner ___E:Baron Hill U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Baron_Hill_(politician))___ , Bayh announced that he would be running to take back his old Senate seat from retiring Republican incumbent Dan Coats.

He was defeated by ___E:Todd Young U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Todd_Young)___ in the ___E:general election U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Senate_election_in_Indiana,_2016)___ by a nearly 10-point margin (52.1% to 42.4%).

On June 15, 2022, President ___E:Joe Biden U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joe_Biden)___ named Bayh to serve as a member of the ___E:President's Intelligence Advisory Board U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/President%27s_Intelligence_Advisory_Board)___ .

From 2001 to 2005, Bayh served as Chairman of the ___E:Democratic Leadership Council U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Democratic_Leadership_Council)___ (DLC).

'We looked at each other,' said Bayh, 'and said, okay, what do we need.'"
On February 15, 2010, Bayh announced he would not seek reelection to a third Senate term in the November 2, 2010, midterm election.

Bayh's announcement came very shortly after former Senator ___E:Dan Coats U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dan_Coats)___ declared his own candidacy for Bayh's Senate seat.  Because he made his announcement the day before the deadline for filing for the ___E:primary U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Partisan_primary)___ , no Democrat was able to gather a sufficient number of signatures to qualify for the primary ballot, so the state party committee chose Congressman ___E:Brad Ellsworth U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brad_Ellsworth)___ as the nominee.

According to the ___E:Associated Press U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Associated_Press)___ , Bayh spent a significant portion of his last year in office searching for a job, holding over four dozen meetings with potential corporate employers between February and December 2010. ___E:Susan Bayh U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Susan_Bayh)___ , Evan Bayh's late wife, has been described by the Fort Wayne Journal Gazette as a "professional board member" or "professional director", having been a director of fourteen corporations since 1994 and being a director of eight as of 2006.
